name: pape
description: Professional Agentic Product Engineering — the field guide's own plugin: an ambient coach that teaches while you work, and an on-demand audit of your repo's agent harness.

plugins.name: pape
plugins.description: Professional Agentic Product Engineering — two skills for operating a coding agent well. /pape:agentic-coach catches teachable moments while you work and surfaces the single most relevant tip from the guide. /pape:harness-audit reads the harness checked into your repo — guidelines, autotests, guardrails — and reports which of the eight tiers hold, which don't, and the one next thing to fix.
